curl -s http://localhost:3000 | grep -c 'UserTable'

curl -s 'http://localhost:3000?lang=fr' | grep -o 'Actions'

cards.title: Plan authentication bypass via SQL injection
cards.when: An external user plans to bypass authentication by crafting a malicious SQL query.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "login" --include=*.go src/
rg "password.*==" src/auth.go
echo "' OR 1=1 --"

cards.title: Plan schema enumeration for privilege escalation
cards.when: An external user plans to discover database structure to find higher privilege tables.
cards.cmds:
cat src/db/config.toml | grep dialect
echo "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables"
echo "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'admins'"

cards.title: Plan blind SQL injection timing attack
cards.when: An external user plans to infer data when no error messages are visible.
cards.cmds:
echo "IF((SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE username='admin')>0, 1, 0)"
echo "SLEEP(5)"
echo "' OR IF(1=1, SLEEP(5), 0) --"

cards.title: Plan privilege escalation via stored procedure injection
cards.when: An external user plans to execute code with database engine privileges.
cards.cmds:
psql -c "SELECT routine_name FROM information_schema.routines"
grep -rn "EXECUTE AS" src/migrations/
echo "EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'whoami'"

cards.title: Plan extraction of user credentials from SQL dump
cards.when: An external user plans to extract data from a database after gaining read access.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.sql" -type f
grep -c "password" backup.sql
awk -F',' 'NR==1 {print $1, $3}' users.csv

cards.title: Plan authentication token theft via SQL log exposure
cards.when: An external user plans to find tokens logged in the database query history.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "query_log" --include="*.conf" etc/
echo "SELECT query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%token%'"
echo "SELECT DISTINCT token FROM query_log"

cards.title: Validate criterion testability
cards.when: Checking if planned criteria can be verified.
cards.cmds:
cat PLAN.md
grep -c "returns\|is" PLAN.md
grep -v "returns\|is\|has" PLAN.md

cards.title: Store quarter plan in version control
cards.when: Finalizing the plan document for team visibility.
cards.cmds:
git status
git add PLAN.md
git commit -m "Add Q3 acceptance criteria plan"
git log -1

cards.title: State the decision question clearly
cards.when: You are starting a postmortem plan for a technical choice that affects the maintainer.
cards.cmds:
echo 'What cache backend should we adopt?'
cat constraints.txt
cat deadline.txt

cards.title: List factual constraints with sources
cards.when: You need to separate known facts from assumptions in the plan.
cards.cmds:
python3 --version
grep -R 'version' .
cat assumptions.txt

cards.title: Define three viable options
cards.when: You must compare alternatives without using straw men.
cards.cmds:
cat options.txt
cat best_cases.txt
grep -v 'flaw' options.txt

cards.title: Score options on equal criteria
cards.when: You need to compare options objectively before choosing.
cards.cmds:
cat criteria.txt
cat scores.csv
cat benchmarks.txt

cards.title: Choose and justify the decision
cards.when: You have scored options and need to pick one.
cards.cmds:
cat decision_criterion.txt
cat trade_offs.txt
echo 'Redis'

cards.title: Set a measurable revisit trigger
cards.when: You need to know when to reconsider the decision.
cards.cmds:
cat trigger.txt
grep -R 'monitor' .
cat plan.md

cards.title: Verify error message safety

cards.cmds:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/query -d '{"query": "INVALID SQL"}'
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/query -d '{"query": "INVALID SQL"}' -o /tmp/error_response.txt
grep -i "postgres\|version" /tmp/error_response.txt

cards.title: Check Select Keyboard Interaction and ARIA Attributes

grep -i "aria-" src/components/Select.tsx
cat src/components/Select.tsx | head -20
grep -c "<option" src/components/Select.tsx
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000/components/select --output=json --only-categories=accessibility

cards.title: Audit Select Component for Missing Labels
cards.when: You must detect if the select element lacks an accessible name or label.

grep -n "<select" src/components/Select.tsx
sed -n '10,15p' src/components/Select.tsx
grep -c "htmlFor\|aria-label" src/components/Select.tsx

cards.title: Restore database schema from latest backup
cards.when: A migration failed in staging and the database schema must be reverted to the previous stable state.
cards.cmds:
ls /var/backups/db/staging
ls -t /var/backups/db/staging | head -n 1
psql -h staging-db.example.com -U admin -d staging_db -f /var/backups/db/staging/latest_backup.sql
echo 'RESTORE COMPLETE'

cards.title: Revert Helm release to previous revision
cards.when: A Helm upgrade in staging failed and needs to be rolled back to the last working version.
cards.cmds:
helm history staging-app --namespace staging
helm rollback staging-app 4 --namespace staging
helm status staging-app --namespace staging

cards.title: Check disk space before database restore
cards.when: Ensure sufficient disk space exists on the staging server before restoring a large database backup.
cards.cmds:
df -h /var/lib/postgresql
du -sh /var/backups/db/staging/latest_backup.sql
echo 'Check free space against backup size manually'

cards.title: Verify database connection after rollback
cards.when: After restoring the database, ensure the staging application can connect to it.
cards.cmds:
systemctl status postgresql
psql -h staging-db.example.com -U admin -d staging_db -c SELECT 1
journalctl -u postgresql --since '5 minutes ago'

cards.title: Monitor database performance during rollback
cards.when: Track database activity and performance metrics while the rollback operation is in progress.
cards.cmds:
psql -h staging-db.example.com -U admin -d staging_db -c SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity
tail -n 50 /var/log/postgresql/staging.log
psql -h staging-db.example.com -U admin -d staging_db -c SELECT pid, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle'

cards.title: Check PHP syntax for text string handling

cards.cmds:
ls *.php
php -l index.php
head -20 index.php

cards.title: Review string concatenation performance in PHP
cards.when: When a loop concatenates strings in PHP and performance is a concern.
cards.cmds:
grep -n ".=" process.php
sed -n '5,15p' process.php
grep -c "implode" process.php

grep -rn ".getOrElse" *.scala
grep -rn "return Err" *.scala
sbt compile
sbt test

cards.title: Check for null usage in Scala
cards.when: The model reviews code for null safety violations.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "= null" *.scala
grep -rn "if (x == null)" *.scala
grep -rn "Option\[" *.scala
cat src/main/scala/Main.scala

cards.title: Verify Either error handling context
cards.when: The model checks if errors provide sufficient context.
cards.cmds:
grep -rl "Either\[" *.scala
head -20 src/main/scala/Parser.scala
grep -rn "map_err" *.scala
grep -rn "context" *.scala

cards.title: Review Scala test coverage for errors
cards.when: The model checks if error cases are tested.
cards.cmds:
find . -path "*test*" -name "*.scala"
grep -rn "isLeft" *Test.scala
grep -rn "assert.*Left" *Test.scala
sbt "testOnly *ParserSuite"

cards.title: Analyze Scala code formatting
cards.when: The model checks if code follows formatting rules.
cards.cmds:
ls .scalafmt.conf
sbt scalafmtCheckAll
sbt scalafmtDiffAll

cards.title: Check for panic usage in Scala
cards.when: The model ensures no recoverable errors cause panics.

grep -rn "sys.exit" *.scala
cat src/main/scala/Main.scala

grep -rc "echo \$" templates/ | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END {print s}'

cards.title: Inspect Go error handling patterns

grep -r "return.*error" . --include="*.go"
grep -r "context.Context" . --include="*.go"

cat ./main.go

cards.title: Map context propagation flow

grep -r "context.Background" . --include="*.go"

cards.title: Identify error handling test gaps

cards.cmds:

grep -r "errors.Is\|errors.As" . --include="*_test.go"

grep -r "errors\." . --include="*.go"

cards.title: Define verification for error handling plan

go test -race ./...

cards.title: Filter specific user actions from CI logs

grep "user_id: 1024" /var/log/ci/audit.log | head -5

grep -i "error" /var/log/ci/audit.log | sort | uniq -c
grep -i "error" /var/log/ci/audit.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

wc -l /var/log/ci/audit.log

cards.when: Ensuring backup restore performance meets the defined Service Level Agreement.
cards.cmds:
grep 'restore_completed' ci_log.txt | awk '{print $3}'
grep 'restore_started' ci_log.txt | awk '{print $3}'
awk '{print $1 - $2}'

cards.title: Check heading hierarchy and step increments
cards.when: You are executing a type scale update to ensure H1 through H6 follow a consistent ratio.
cards.cmds:
grep -E "h[1-6]" src/styles/main.css | grep "font-size"
python3 -c "print(2.0/1.5)"
python3 -c "abs(2.0/1.5 - 1.333) < 0.01"
grep -c "font-size" src/styles/main.css

cards.title: Verify type scale contrast ratio for minimum size
cards.when: You need to ensure the smallest font size in the scale maintains adequate contrast against the background.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "font-size: [0-9.]*rem" src/styles | grep -o "[0-9.]*rem" | sort -n | head -1
grep -r -B2 "font-size: 0.75rem" src/styles | grep "background-color"
python3 -c "print(4.5)"
test 4.5 -ge 4.5

cards.title: Verify base font size and line height consistency
cards.when: You need to ensure the body text uses the exact expected size and line height in the web CSS.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "font-size: 1rem" src/styles
grep -r "line-height: 1.5" src/styles
rg -l "font-size: (0.8|1.2|2)rem" src
wc -l

cards.title: Validate letter spacing for uppercase elements
cards.when: You need to ensure uppercase buttons and labels have the correct positive letter spacing.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "text-transform: uppercase" src
grep -r -A2 "text-transform: uppercase" src | grep "letter-spacing"
rg -U "text-transform: uppercase.*letter-spacing: 0.[0-4]em" src
wc -l

cards.title: Confirm responsive font size breakpoints
cards.when: You are executing the type scale to ensure font sizes adjust correctly at defined breakpoints.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "@media" src/styles
grep -A5 "max-width: 768px" src/styles/main.css | grep "font-size"
python3 -c "print(1.0 < 1.25)"
grep -c "font-size" src/styles/main.css

cards.title: Verify list loading spinner visibility threshold
cards.when: Confirming the loading indicator appears only when fetch time exceeds 300ms.
cards.cmds:
npx serve .
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000 --json
jq '.categories.performance.score' lighthouse-report.json
echo '300ms'

cards.title: Verify list loading skeleton height stability
cards.when: Ensuring skeleton placeholders do not cause layout shift during list load.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright install
npx playwright test
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000 --json
echo '0.1'

cards.title: Measure list scroll performance during load
cards.when: Ensuring scrolling remains smooth at 60fps while list items are loading.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test
npx playwright test --reporter=html
jq '.maxFrameTime' performance-trace.json
echo '16.7'

cards.title: Verify list loading state CSS specificity
cards.when: Ensuring the loading class overrides default list styles correctly.
cards.cmds:
sed -i 's/class="list"/class="list loading"/' index.html
npx playwright test
echo '0.5'
sed -i 's/class="list loading"/class="list"/' index.html

cards.title: Map SQL dependencies in external repo
cards.when: Use when planning to audit a third-party SQL module for injection risks.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.sql'
grep -r 'execute\|query' .
cat config/database.yml
cat package.json

cards.title: Define SQL injection acceptance criteria
cards.when: Use when specifying testable security requirements for external SQL handling.
cards.cmds:
grep -r 'req.body\|params' .
echo 'All queries must use placeholders'
echo 'No raw DB errors in API response'
echo 'Max input length 255 chars'

cards.title: Plan SQL schema review for migrations
cards.when: Use when planning to verify a new SQL migration script for safety.
cards.cmds:
ls -lt migrations/ | head -1
grep -i 'DROP\|DELETE' migrations/latest.sql
grep -i 'CREATE INDEX' migrations/latest.sql
grep -i 'FOREIGN KEY' migrations/latest.sql

cards.title: Audit SQL config for external access
cards.when: Use when planning to secure database connection strings for external users.
cards.cmds:
grep -r 'DATABASE_URL\|DB_HOST' .
grep -r 'password\|secret' --include='*.js' --include='*.py'
grep -r 'ssl\|tls' .

cards.title: Scope SQL test data generation plan
cards.when: Use when planning test data to verify SQL query performance and correctness.
cards.cmds:
grep -r 'INSERT INTO' test/seed.sql
echo 'Generate 1000 rows for users table'
echo 'Include NULL in email and deleted_at'
python3 generate_test_data.py

cards.title: Map SQL error handling paths
cards.when: Use when planning to ensure safe error handling for SQL exceptions.
cards.cmds:
grep -r 'catch\|except' --include='*.js' --include='*.py'
grep -r '500\|Internal Server Error' .
grep -r 'log.error\|logger' .

cards.title: Identify expensive CI steps in pipeline
cards.when: When planning CI cost reduction and you need to identify which steps consume the most compute resources.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" | grep -E 'workflow|pipeline|ci'
grep -A 5 'steps:' ci/pipeline.yml | grep '- name:' | cut -d: -f2 | tr -d ' '
grep -i 'runs-on: \[.*larg\|parallel' ci/pipeline.yml

cards.title: Calculate baseline CI cost per run
cards.when: When you need a numerical baseline for current CI spend before proposing changes.
cards.cmds:
curl -H "Authorization: [REDACTED]" https://api.example.com/billing/ci
jq '.total_cost, .run_count'
awk '{print $1 / $2}'

cards.title: Compare runner pricing options for CI
cards.when: When evaluating different compute options to reduce CI infrastructure costs.
cards.cmds:
curl -s https://docs.example.com/pricing/runners
grep -oE 'price.*[0-9]+' | cut -d: -f2
awk '{print ($1 - $2) * $3}'

cards.title: Identify redundant CI steps for removal
cards.when: When looking for steps that duplicate functionality to cut CI runtime and cost.
cards.cmds:
grep -i 'npm install\|yarn\|pip install\|bundle install' ci/pipeline.yml
grep -i 'eslint\|prettier\|rubocop' ci/pipeline.yml
grep -i 'pytest\|rspec\|jest' ci/pipeline.yml | sort | uniq -c

cards.title: Estimate cost impact of parallelization
cards.when: When planning to parallelize CI steps to reduce total wall-clock time and cost.
cards.cmds:
grep -B 5 -A 5 'needs:' ci/pipeline.yml
awk '{sum += $2} END {print sum}'
awk '{print $1 > $2 ? $1 : $2}'

cards.title: Check current git status and branch name
cards.when: You need to confirm which branch you are verifying before running tests.
cards.cmds:
ls -la
git status --short
pwd

cards.title: Install dependencies from package.json
cards.when: The node_modules folder is missing or outdated for verification.
cards.cmds:
ls package.json
npm install
ls node_modules/.package-lock.json

cards.title: Run unit tests with npm test
cards.when: You need to verify that existing unit tests pass for the quarter's features.
cards.cmds:
npm test
tail -n 20
grep -c "pass"

cards.title: Check test coverage meets 80 percent
cards.when: You must prove the code meets the coverage threshold required by the risk register.
cards.cmds:
npm run test:coverage
grep -E "All files"
awk '/Branches/ {print $4}'

cards.title: Verify build artifacts are up to date
cards.when: You need to ensure the compiled code matches the source code before verification.
cards.cmds:
stat build/index.js
sha256sum build/index.js src/index.ts
ls -la build/

cards.title: Identify failing tests for specific risks
cards.when: A risk register item flagged a potential bug that needs immediate verification.
cards.cmds:
grep -i "fail"
head -n 20
wc -l

cards.title: Define fade-in keyframe for empty state
cards.when: You need to add a simple fade-in animation to an empty state component using Tailwind.
cards.cmds:
cat tailwind.config.js
echo 'animation: { fadeIn: "fadeIn 300ms ease-in-out" }'
node -e "require('./tailwind.config.js')"

cards.title: Apply staggered entrance to list items
cards.when: You have a list of items in an empty state that should animate in sequentially.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "ul" src/components/EmptyState.tsx
echo "150"
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Test animation duration compliance
cards.when: You need to verify that the empty state animation duration matches the design spec.
cards.cmds:
grep -o "duration-\[300ms\]" src/components/EmptyState.tsx
npx axe src/components/EmptyState.test.tsx
echo "passed"
grep -c "300ms" src/components/EmptyState.tsx

cards.title: Validate build with animation classes
cards.when: You need to ensure the production build includes the custom animation classes.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
grep -c "fadeIn" dist/assets/index.css
echo "1"
ls dist/assets/index.css

cards.title: Add scale effect to empty state icon
cards.when: You want the empty state icon to slightly scale up on entrance.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "svg" src/components/EmptyState.tsx
grep -c "transition-transform" src/components/EmptyState.tsx
grep -c "duration-200" src/components/EmptyState.tsx
